## POST `/api/2.29/alert-watchers`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Create an alert watcher to receive array alert messages.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |
| `names` | query | array of string | yes | A comma-separated list of resource names. |

**Request body** (optional): `AlertWatcherPost`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `minimum_notification_severity` | string | The minimum severity that an alert must have in order for emails to be sent to the watcher. Possible values include `info`, `warning`, and `critical`. If not specified, defaults to `info`. |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `AlertWatcherResponse`

## PATCH `/api/2.29/alert-watchers`

**Tier:** T2 (T3 if it destroys, eradicates, disables or overwrites)  

Modify an alert watcher’s configuration. Enable or disable an alert watcher privilege and select the level of alert notification of an alert watcher. Alert notification levels are `info`, `warning`, or `critical`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |
| `ids` | query | array of string |  | A comma-separated list of resource IDs. If after filtering, there is not at least one resource that matches each of the elements of `ids`, then an error is returned. This cannot be provided together with the `name` or… |
| `names` | query | array of string |  | Performs the operation on the unique names specified. Enter multiple names in comma-separated format. For example, `name01,name02`. If there is not at least one resource that matches each of the elements of `names`,… |

**Request body** (required): `AlertWatcher`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (read-only) | A non-modifiable, globally unique ID chosen by the system. |
| `name` | string (read-only) | Name of the object (e.g., a file system or snapshot). |
| `enabled` | boolean | Is email notification enabled? If not specified, defaults to `true`. |
| `minimum_notification_severity` | string | The minimum severity that an alert must have in order for emails to be sent to the watcher. Possible values include `info`, `warning`, and `critical`. |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `AlertWatcherResponse`
